preconditions.description: The number of acorns n must be between 1 and 500,000.
The length of the Euler tour list a must be 2n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each element in the Euler tour list a must be between 0 and n.

postconditions.description: If no valid Euler tour exists, output 'no'. Otherwise, output 'yes' followed by a valid Euler tour of length 2n - 1.

postconditions.expression: any(a_i != 0 for a_i in a) and a[0] == a[-1]
postconditions.description: The valid Euler tour must start and end with the same acorn, and at least one acorn must be specified.

postconditions.expression: all(a_i in range(1, n + 1) for a_i in a if a_i != 0)
postconditions.description: All specified acorns in the Euler tour must be valid indices between 1 and n.
